display.purpose: Hero headlines, page titles. Ultra-light, massive scale.

headline.purpose: Section titles, product names. Light weight.

label.purpose: Interface chrome — nav, tags, form labels, table headers. Uppercase, tracked.

components.name: Primary Button (Cyan CTA)
components.description: The highest-contrast button. Electric cyan on ink. Use for Submit, Send, Browse, Contact, Learn More.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00D4FF; color: #111111; padding: 14px 32px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.7rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border: none; border-radius: 4px; transition: background 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #33DDFF; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0099CC; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with cyan border and text. Use for Contact Us, View All.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #00D4FF; padding: 14px 32px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.7rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3); border-radius: 4px; transition: background 250ms, border-color 250ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1); border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.5); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Surface card with cyan line border. Border brightens on hover. Key specs inline.
components.html:
GATE VALVE

Gate Valve DN50

DN50 · PN16 · CI
components.css: .ds-card-product { background: #222222; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2); overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 250ms, box-shadow 250ms; } .ds-card-product:hover { border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1); } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio: 1; background: #2A2A2A; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-cover; transition: opacity 250ms; } .ds-card-product:hover .ds-card-image img { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-card-tag { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #00D4FF; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 400; font-size: 1rem; color: #E0E0E0; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-card-title:hover { color: #00D4FF; } .ds-card-specs { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888888; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Surface-raised background, cyan-tinted border, cyan glow on focus. Mono label above.
components.css: .ds-input-label { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #00D4FF; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background: #2A2A2A; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 1rem; color: #E0E0E0; transition: border-color 250ms, box-shadow 250ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #555555; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15); }

components.name: Technical Data Table
components.description: Full-width data table with cyan headers, line borders, mono throughout. The hero component.
components.css: .ds-data-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 1rem 0; } .ds-data-table thead { background: #2A2A2A; } .ds-data-table th { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #00D4FF; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #333333; } .ds-data-table td { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #E0E0E0; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #333333; } .ds-data-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.03); } .ds-data-table tbody tr td:first-child { color: #888888; font-weight: 400; } .ds-data-table tbody tr td:last-child { color: #E0E0E0; }

components.name: Cyan Divider
components.description: The signature section divider. Cyan gradient line that fades to transparent.
components.css: .ds-cyan-divider { height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #00D4FF, transparent); width: 100%; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Light title + mono label + cyan gradient line.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #00D4FF; } .ds-section-title { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 3rem); font-weight: 300; color: #E0E0E0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-section-line { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3), transparent); } .ds-section-header { margin-bottom: 32px; }

narrative.overview:
PLOVER's digital presence reads like a precision engineering workstation — the kind of interface a valve engineer would trust with critical specifications. The world is a neutral dark gray canvas (#1A1A1A) overlaid with a subtle grid pattern, evoking graph paper and CAD environments. Every surface is defined by thin lines: cyan electric borders (#00D4FF) trace the edges of cards, tables, and panels, while monospace type carries the authority of technical data sheets.

Typography serves the data. Inter provides clean, readable body text at display scale, but JetBrains Mono is the voice of the interface — navigation labels, category tags, parameter names, and specification values all speak in monospace. The grid background is the constant reminder: this is a space for precision, for engineers who measure twice.

Motion is quick and functional. Transitions resolve in 200-300ms — fast enough to feel responsive, slow enough to track. No decorative easing, no cinematic drift.
keyCharacteristics: Grid Canvas — A subtle 40px grid pattern overlays the entire void, the blueprint graph paper.
Cyan Line Work — Electric cyan (#00D4FF) defines every interactive edge and data highlight.
Monospace Voice — Mono isn't just for data values — it's the interface language.
Data-First Density — Information is dense and scannable. Specifications are the hero.
Sharp Precision — Corner radii are minimal (2-6px). Everything feels machined, not molded.

rules.name: The Cyan Line Rule
rules.body: Every card, every container, every input is defined by a 1px border at rgba(0,212,255,0.2). On hover, the border brightens to rgba(0,212,255,0.4) with a faint cyan glow. Never shadow — always line.

rules.name: The Grid Rule
rules.body: The 40px grid background is present on every page. It's subtle but constant. Never remove it.

rules.name: The Mono Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used for ALL interface chrome: navigation labels, category tags, table headers, timestamps, metadata, form labels, and technical data values. Body text and headlines remain in Inter.

rules.name: The Uppercase Label Rule
rules.body: All mono labels are uppercase with 0.08em letter-spacing. This creates a consistent technical tag appearance.

rules.name: The Line-Only Rule
rules.body: Never use drop shadows for depth. Depth is conveyed by border brightness and background layer separation.

dos: Do keep the grid background on every page — it's the blueprint canvas.
Do use cyan (#00D4FF) for CTAs, focus states, active indicators, and data highlights.
Do use monospace (JetBrains Mono) for all interface chrome — labels, tags, nav, table headers.
Do define cards and containers with cyan line borders, not shadows.
Do keep corner radii small (2-6px) — precision over softness.
Do make data tables dense and scannable — engineers scan, they don't read.
donts: Don't use warm colors (gold, amber, orange) — the palette is cool and neutral.
Don't use drop shadows for depth — use line borders and layer separation.
Don't use large corner radii — anything above 8px feels wrong here.
Don't hide technical data behind interactions — show it inline, show it dense.
Don't use monospace for body text or headlines — only for interface chrome and data.
Don't remove the grid background — it's structural, not decorative.
Don't use decorative gradients or blur effects — keep it sharp and technical.
